name: DaoCloud
note: Container platform vendor. Broad upstream coverage; upstream whitelists are adjusted without notice.

name: 1ms.run
note: Commercial acceleration service with a free public tier. Observed from two different networks (2026-09-22): layers answer quickly, but blob downloads are regularly cut off mid-read. The probe records that as a failed throughput rather than smoothing it over — a pull that cannot finish is a pull that fails.

name: hub.rat.dev
note: Little public information about the operator. It answers by redirecting to docker.1ms.run, so it behaves like that mirror and stands or falls with it. Listed because people use it, not because it is recommended.
